# Rekordis

> Rekordis is a route editor for bikes, e-bikes and scooters. Import GPS tracks, refine routes, add notes and video moments, and share maps that visitors can open without signing in.

## Product

- [Website](https://rekordis.com/): Product overview.
- [Route editor](https://app.rekordis.com/): Create and manage your route library.
- [Russian website](https://ru.rekordis.com/): Russian product overview.
- [Source and documentation](https://github.com/IgorShadurin/rekordis.com): Features, development, deployment, and privacy documentation.

Routes support GPX, KML, GeoJSON and CSV import and export. Users can edit tracks, attach notes and YouTube video moments, and choose whether to share a route. Public maps do not require visitor registration. Maps and embedded videos require an internet connection.
